scope: retrospective audit and prospective shortlist only

primary.features: frozen B5-R mean, all-atom pooled, element SOAP and scalar Activation cosine kernels
primary.success_gate: SOAP+Activation must improve MAE in both fold schemes, avoid ranking deterioration in both, show positive lower 95% paired improvement in both and blocked permutation p<=0.05 in both. Delta_abs is secondary.

bootstrap_unit.anion-family-held-out: held-out anion family; descriptive with 4 clusters

candidate.strategy_rank_ties: within category prefer split Top-5 membership, then larger rank span, then better best rank, then edge ID; round robin across categories, no eligibility relaxation.

local_four_anion_screen.interpretation: flag for review, not independently a confirmed duplicate

li_soap_confirm.scope: 24 new candidates and 14 development pathways with identical cached SOAP layout
